name: tar extracts archives
lines: tar -cf f.tar --sort=name forest; rm -r forest; tar -xvf f.tar; echo s$?
mkdir out; tar -xf f.tar -C out forest/cave; ls -l out out/forest out/forest/cave
tar -czf l.tgz --sort=name library; mkdir two; tar -xvzf l.tgz --directory=two; ls -l two/library

tar -cf m.tar /etc/motd 2>/dev/null; tar -xvf m.tar; ls -l etc etc/motd

lines:

' > crlf; printf 'caf\xc3\xa9
' > cafe; printf 'abc\x01
' > ctl; : > empty; file one noeol crlf cafe ctl empty

printf '#!/bin/sh
echo
